title: agaye haram hoga arbaee'n
body:
aagaye haram hoga arbaeen
<<DIVIDER>>
gham ke paasban dard ke ameen aaye qaid se abide hazeen
farshe khaak par hai falak nasheen
<<MINI>>
aagaye haram hoga....
<<DIVIDER>>
tauq bediyan aur reesma sar pe gir pada jaise aasman
ghamzada falak roti hai zameen

aagaye haram hoga....

dekhiye mera zakhmi hai gala nange paon mai kaaton par chala
aisi bebasi hogi kya kahin

zindagi se ye maut hai bhali ay mere chacha sheh ki zindagi

dukhte hai mere sab ye us suqan kis-se mai karoon haale dil bayan
keh rahe hai ye abide hazeen

akbare jawan mere bhai jaan saath tum nahi khaak hai jahan
yaad karti hai zainabe hazeen

sar kata diya ghar luta diya deen ko magar tu bacha liya

aagaye haram hoga....

dafn jo hui dekho parde may nange sar kabhi thi jo balwe may
uski betiyan dar badar phiri

<<DIVIDER>>
karbala may ab dekho ek baar gham may doob kar hogaya ye haal
sayyeda ke saath fakhre mursali
